guardrails.description: Filters inappropriate or off-topic content before and after querying the model.

guardrails.topicAreaDesc: Besides limiting the allowed topics, it guides the content of every OVA: the teacher's topic is interpreted within the area, and examples, cases and vocabulary come from it. An overly narrow area may prevent any generation.
guardrails.topicAreaHelp: Describe the area in a few words, for example "database management systems and Oracle".
guardrails.topicUnrestrictedNow: Currently: unrestricted, can generate on any topic.
